about_page.trusted_center: Raipur’s Trusted Homeopathic Care Center Since 1983
about_page.description_1: Dr. Trivedi's Homeopathy Clinic was founded in 1983 by the respected Dr. Vidyakant Trivedi, with a vision to provide safe, effective, and holistic healing through classical homeopathy.
about_page.description_2: Continuing this proud legacy, Dr. Uttkarsh Trivedi, a dynamic and award-winning homeopathic physician, now leads the clinic with dedication and innovation.

about_page.uttkarsh_description: Dr. Uttkarsh Trivedi is a distinguished homeopathic physician with over 9 years of clinical experience. Carrying forward the legacy of his father, he has made Dr. Trivedi’s Homeopathy Clinic a symbol of hope and healing not just in Raipur, but across India and abroad.
about_page.vision_text: To become a leading center for holistic healing through homeopathy, empowering individuals to achieve long-term health and wellness by treating the root cause of disease—naturally, safely, and compassionately.
mission_points: Uphold trust, ethics, and patient-centric values.
Continue the legacy of excellence since 1983.

Honored in Dubai at Burj Al Arab with the “Best Skin Care Specialist” award by famous cricketer Chris Gayle.

Honored in Germany by former England cricket captain Eoin Morgan.
Honored in Goa with the “Internal Flame of Homeopathy Award” by Australian fast bowler Brett Lee.

formula_master.title: Quick Prescription Formula Master
formula_master.subtitle: Loaded formula rules for your login session will be managed here. Saving/activating will instantly update your current session.
formula_master.help_basics_desc: Formula sets define the master rules for parsing doctor notes and quick entries during patient consultations.
formula_master.help_basics_name_detail: Name your formula set (e.g. "Default Quick Formula") to organize different pricing or dosage rules for your clinic.
formula_master.help_basics_active_detail: Enables this formula set for active consultation note parsing.
formula_master.help_basics_default_detail: Marks this formula set as the primary fallback ruleset for all doctor consultations.
formula_master.help_basics_published_detail: Publishes the formula set so it is available live during patient visits.
formula_master.help_numeric_desc: These rules control how numbers typed in the doctor's consultation form (e.g., 30, 200/2, 84/20) are automatically converted into medicine charges and dosage schedules.
formula_master.help_numeric_plain_detail: Used when a doctor types a single standalone number (like "30"). The system recognizes it as Medicine Code 30, sets a flat price (e.g. ₹80), and attaches the default 4-4-4 dosage schedule.
formula_master.help_numeric_single_detail: Used when typing a number with a 1-digit slash suffix (like "200/2"). Here, "200" is the medicine code and "2" is the duration multiplier (e.g., 2 weeks). Total Price = Suffix (2) × Multiplier (₹100) = ₹200.
formula_master.help_numeric_double_detail: Used when typing a number with a 2-digit slash suffix (like "84/20"). "84" is the medicine code and "20" is the quantity. Total Price = Suffix (20) × Multiplier (₹10) = ₹200.
formula_master.help_templates_desc: Dosage templates define how medicine doses are distributed throughout the day (Morning, Afternoon, Night) and what instructions to give the patient.
formula_master.help_templates_code_detail: A short unique code used by rules and alpha codes to apply this exact dosage schedule.
formula_master.help_templates_dose_detail: Defines the time of day the patient should take the medication.
formula_master.help_templates_balls_detail: The number of homeopathic pills or globules to take in each single dose (e.g., 4 balls).
formula_master.help_templates_instructions_detail: Optional directions printed on the prescription (e.g., "Empty stomach" or "After meals").
formula_master.help_alpha_desc: Alpha shortcodes are medical abbreviations (like BD, TDS, QID) typed in the consultation form to quickly set pricing, duration, and dosage.
formula_master.help_alpha_code_detail: The quick text abbreviation typed by the doctor during consultation (e.g., "10/BD").
formula_master.help_alpha_price_detail: Fixed price automatically applied to the prescription when this alpha code is typed.
formula_master.help_alpha_template_detail: Maps the alpha code directly to its timing template (e.g. BD → Morning & Night).
formula_master.help_alpha_days_detail: Customizes or overrides the total prescription duration in days when this code is used.
